newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO LOSE GROUND ON LEADERS WITH GOALLESS DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO LOSE GROUND ON LEADERS WITH GOALLESS DRAW.

text.p: Reigning Spanish champions Atletico Madrid lost a chance to make up ground on the leaders after being held to a goalless draw in a scrappy game at Sevilla on Thursday.
Atletico's best chance fell to midfielder Juan Vizcaino who had time to pick his spot after picking up a rebound but blasted the ball wide just five minutes from the final whistle.
The result leaves Atletico with 10 points from six games, four adrift of Real Madrid and Barcelona.
